FROZEN, and the history is the reason. Recorded 2026-08-20 on this corpus's first run as SUSPECT, because the verdict it captured was believed wrong at the time of recording: a confident, uncaveated hit (found_on_compilation=True, song_not_found=False) for a song that exists nowhere -- TRACK_ON_COMPILATION's last-resort branch (`if not results and keyword_matches and not discogs_found_releases`) surfaced the best library keyword hit when Discogs returned nothing, and the compilation Outcome labelled it confirmed. That is the LML#1225 user-visible failure reached by a path #1225's tracklist gate never covers, because no tracklist is consulted. LML#1239 (commit 0fce58ac) fixed exactly that branch, and this case flipped to song_not_found=True / found_on_compilation=False when the corpus was re-landed against main on 2026-08-23. The row itself is still returned -- the fix caveats it rather than suppressing it. Frozen now because the failure it pins reached production once; re-recording it requires a hand-edit and a reason.
